verses.1: Unto the end. For the octave. A Psalm of David.
verses.2: Save me, O Lord, because holiness has passed away, because truths have been diminished, before the sons of men.
verses.3: They have been speaking emptiness, each one to his neighbor; they have been speaking with deceitful lips and a duplicitous heart.
verses.4: May the Lord scatter all deceitful lips, along with the tongue that speaks malice.
verses.5: They have said: “We will magnify our tongue; our lips belong to us. Who is our Lord?”
verses.6: Because of the misery of the destitute and the groaning of the poor, now I will arise, says the Lord. I will place him in safety. I will act faithfully toward him.
verses.7: The eloquence of the Lord is pure eloquence, silver tested by fire, purged from the earth, refined seven times.
verses.8: You, O Lord, will preserve us, and you will guard us from this generation into eternity.
verses.9: The impious wander aimlessly. According to your loftiness, you have multiplied the sons of men. [ Psalm 12 ] (13)
